description: Two admitted candidates with distinct canonical address identity (one added_in_state, one added_in_config) in one scope, driven through the production Postgres fact writer over an InstrumentedDB-wrapped counting fake. WriteTerraformConfigStateDriftFindings calls the shared factwrite.BatchInsertVersionedFacts bounded chunked bulk insert (batch size 1000): two rows fit one chunk, plus the generation-authoritative retire, so eshu_dp_postgres_query_duration_seconds records exactly 2 write observations and statements_executed=2. Any increase — an N+1 write-per-candidate regression — trips the gate; the companion N+1 negative control test proves this by calling the writer once per candidate (one insert plus one retire each, 4 observations) and asserting the count exceeds this budget. Added for issue #6416: the config_state_drift cost axis was exempted on the false premise of no write path, but the Postgres write path is implemented, wired, and already cost-bounded.
